snippet.title: Paint Path | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #PaintPath

🎨 Paint Path Launch Trailer 🎨
🖌️ Available for Playstation 4, Playstation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

In Paint Path, every step is a brushstroke! This charming pixel-art puzzle lets you explore artistic paths filled with color and creativity. The sound design reacts to your movements, making each painting action part of a cozy and relaxing experience.

KEY FEATURES
🎨 The color system is the heart of the game
🎨 Charming and relaxing puzzle gameplay
🎨 30 handcrafted levels

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
🎨 Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016813
🎨 Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/paint-path-xbox-series/9p5747gbd6tv
🎨 Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/paint-path-xbox-one/9nk884p9796g
🎨 Microsoft Store (Windows): https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/paint-path-windows/9nm50wr9xgv8
🎨 Nintendo Switch EU: https://x.gd/663lz
🎨 Nintendo Switch US: https://x.gd/KUWR8
